item.title: TODAY! The Neo-Luddites Go to College
item.description: U.S. colleges are welcoming their most tech-critical cohorts of students since the 1960s. On and off campus, they are organizing against data centers and social media platforms, demanding the right to refuse AI, and rejecting cruel futurist narratives and reactionary data politics. How can educators meet these students where they are? Join Dr. Matt Seybold, host of The American Vandal podcast, to learn how TODAY at 6pm in Sage 3303.

item.title: RPI Libraries now requires accessing Elsevier databases through your RCS ID
item.description: Going forward, please use your RCS ID to access the following databases, even while on campus: ScienceDirect, Scopus, Engineering Village (Compendex & INSPEC), Knovel, and LeapSpace. Installing LibKey Nomad can help make this transition seamless.

item.title: Deep Learning for Process-Structure-Property Relationship in Advanced Manufacturing
item.description: Understanding and controlling the process–structure–property relationship is central to advancing manufacturing. This talk presents AI/ML methods that study manufacturing processes and material properties through physically meaningful intermediate representations. We begin with droplet evolution modeling in inkjet printing, where diffusion-corrected neural operator learning characterizes process-level dynamics that govern material deposition and initial geometric fidelity. item.title: Leading from Anywhere: Frontline Leadership
item.description: At RPI, we maintain that “leadership” involves a learnable set of actions and behaviors that is available to everyone. Whether it be leading a particular project or initiative, assisting others in overcoming obstacles and capitalizing on opportunities, or catalyzing co-creation with colleagues, Rensselaer community members model leadership every day.
